ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can retrieve attributes of nodes that have an extended NodeID that reference a Server different than the originating Server. This requires a connection to the remote Server for access (not necessarily displayed as a connection). It is acceptable that the Server configuration information be pre-configured on the Client.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Client Write Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Write Service to write values to one or more Attributes of one or more Nodes. Clients shall use bulk operations whenever possible to reduce the number of Service invocations.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Client Write by Index
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the IndexRange to select a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is an array.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Client Write ByteString by Index
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the IndexRange to select a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is a ByteString.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Client Write Complex
ConformanceUnit.Description: Write and Encode Values with structured DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Client Write Quality & Timestamp
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Write Service to also write StatusCode and/or Timestamps along with a Value.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Client Write SessionLess
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Write Service with the SessionLessInvoke Service.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Client Write String by Index
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the IndexRange to select a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is a String.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Historical Read
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the HistoryRead Service. The details of what aspects of this service are used are listed in additional ConformanceUnits, but at least one of ReadRaw, ReadProcessed, ReadModified, ReadAtTime or ReadEvents shall be supported.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Historical Update
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the HistoryUpdate service. The details of the supported features of this service are described by additional ConformanceUnits, but at least one of the following shall be supported: InsertData, InsertEvents, ReplaceData, ReplaceEvents, UpdateData, UpdateEvents, DeleteData, DeleteEvents or DeleteAtTime.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Read
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the Read Service to read one or more Attributes of one or more Nodes. This includes support of the IndexRange parameter to read a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is an array.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Read Complex
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports reading and encoding Values with structured DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Write Complex
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports writing and decoding Values with structured DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Write Index
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the IndexRange to write a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is an array and partial updates is allowed for this array.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Write StatusCode & Timestamp
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports writing of StatusCode and Timestamps along with the Value.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Attribute Write Values
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports writing to values to one or more Attributes of one or more Nodes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing Client Audit ID
ConformanceUnit.Description: Client supports generating AuditEvents ids and providing them to Servers.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing Client Subscribes
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client supports subscribing for AuditEvents and storing / processing them in a secure manner.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing Connections
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports AuditEvents for establishing and keeping connections. Includes exposing the DataTypes AnonymousIdentityToken, UserIdentityToken, UserNameIdentityToken, X509IdentityToken, WssIdentityToken, SignedSoftwareCertificate, and SecurityTokenRequestType, their Encoding Objects and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace. Includes exposing the EventTypes AuditEventType, AuditSecurityEventType, AuditChannelEventType , AuditOpenSecureChannelEventType, AuditSessionEventType, AuditCreateSessionEventType, AuditActivateSessionEventType, AuditCancelEventType, AuditCertificateEventTypem AuditCertificateDataMismatchEventType, AuditCertificateExpiredEventType, AuditCertificateInvalidEventType, AuditCertificateUntrustedEventType, AuditCertificateRevokedEventType, and AuditCertificateMismatchEventType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing History Services
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports AuditEvents for changing historical information using the HistoryUpdate Service. Includes exposing the EventTypes AuditHistoryUpdateEventType, AuditUpdateEventType and AuditEventType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing Method
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports AuditEvents for calling Methods. Includes exposing the EventTypes AuditUpdateMethodEventType and AuditEventType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing NodeManagement
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports AuditEvents for adding and removing Nodes and References using the NodeManagement Services. Includes exposing the DataTypes AddNodesItem, AddReferencesItem, DeleteNodesItem, and DeleteReferencesItem, their Encoding Objects and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace. Includes exposing the EventTypes AuditEventType, AuditNodeManagementEventType, AuditAddNodesEventType, AuditDeleteNodesEventType, AuditAddReferencesEventType, AuditDeleteReferencesEventType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing Secure Communication
ConformanceUnit.Description: Security related Audit Events shall be provided over an encrypted channel. An encrypted channel can be an OPC UA Secure Conversation with encryption enabled or a transport that includes encryption (like IPSec).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing Services
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support AuditEvents for all Services supported by the Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing UpdateStates
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the AuditUpdateStateEventType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace and one state machine providing Events of that Type.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Auditing Write
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports AuditEvents for changing attributes using the Write Service. Includes exposing the EventTypes AuditWriteUpdateEventType, AuditUpdateEventType, and AuditEventType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Authorization Service Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the RequestAccessToken Method defined in UA Part 12.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Authorization Service Configuration Server
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the Object Types defined in UA Part 12 to allow configuration of information needed to accept Access Tokens when presented by the Client during session establishment. Access Tokens are issued by Authorization Services.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Azure Identity Provider Authority Profile
ConformanceUnit.Description: This unit indicates support of the Azure identity provider to request access tokens. The URI for the interactions with this authority is "http://opcfoundation.org/UA/Authorization#Azure"

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Data Client ResendData Method
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client makes use of ResendData Method to fetch the last value of the data monitored items.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info AssociatedWith
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ReferenceType AssociatedWith and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Audio Type
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the AudioVariableType VariableType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace. Exposes the AudioDataType DataType and its encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Available States and Transitions
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the Properties AvailableStates and AvailableTransitions defined for the FiniteStateMachineType.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Base Types
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports type information of the base OPC UA concepts, like build-in DataTypes, base Object- and VariableTypes, and base ReferenceTypes. Includes the Encoding Objects for the DataTypes that are not Build-in or abstract DataTypes. Exposes the ObjectTypes BaseObjectType, FolderType, DataTypeEncodingType and ModellingRuleType in the AddressSpace. Exposes the VariableTypes BaseVariableType, PropertyType, and BaseDataVariableType in the AddressSpace. Exposes the DataTypes BaseDataType Boolean, ByteString, DateTime, DataValue, DiagnosticsInfo, Enumeration, ExpandedNodeId, Guid, LocalizedText, NodeId, Number, QualifiedName, String, Structure, XmlElement, Integer, UInteger, Double, Float, Sbyte, Int16, Int32, Int64, Byte, Uint16, Uint32, Uint64, StatusCode, UtcTime, Duration, NumericRange, EnumValueType, and Union and their Encoding Objects in the AddressSpace. Exposes the ReferenceTypes References, HierarchicalReferences, NonHierarchicalReferences, HasChild, Organizes, HasModellingRule, HasTypeDefinition, HasEncoding, Aggregates, HasSubtype, HasComponent, and HasProperty in the AddressSpace Exposes the Objects Optional, Mandatory, OptionalPlaceholder, MandatoryPlaceholder and ExposesItsArrayin the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info BitFieldMaskDataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the BitFieldMaskDataType DataType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Choice States
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support Guard Variables and optionally Choice States on StateMachine instances.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Available States and Transitions
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Properties AvailableStates and AvailableTransitions when exposed by a Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Basic
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client uses the defined OPC UA AddressSpace. Access or provide access to Server information like the Server's state, BuildInfo, capabilities, Namespace Table and Type Model.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Change Events
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client processes ModelChangeEvents to detect changes in the Server's OPC UA AddressSpace and take appropriate action for a given change.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Choice States
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use Guard Variables and Choice States on StateMachine instances.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Currency
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the CurrencyUnit Property on DataVariables that represent currency.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Device Failure
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client makes use of DeviceFailureEventType to detect failed devices in underlying systems

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Diagnostics
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client provides interactive or programmatic access to the Server's diagnostic information.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Estimated Return Time
ConformanceUnit.Description: Client uses the EstimatedReturnTime Property to govern the reconnect logic.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Events
ConformanceUnit.Description: A Server is also a Client that produces AuditClientEvents.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client FileDirectoryType Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can access a FileDirectoryType Object to use file directories.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client FileType Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can access a FileType Object to transfer a file from the Server to the Client. This includes large files.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client FileType Write
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can access a FileType Object to transfer a file from the Client to the Server. This includes large files.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Finite State Machine Instance
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use instances of the FinitStateMachineType or a sub-type. Monitor either the CurrentState component Variable of the instance or the Events triggered as effect of state changes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client GetMonitoredItems Method
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client makes use of GetMonitoredItems Method to recover for communication interruptions and/or to recover subscription information.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Honour Operation Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client shall honour Server limits described in ServerCapabilites Object of Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Progress Events
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client makes use of ProgressEvents, including checking for their support.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Remote Nodes
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can access Nodes that have an extended NodeID that reference a Server different then the orginating Server. It is acceptable that the Server configuration information be pre-configured on the Client.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client RequestServerStateChange
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can invoke the RequestServerStateChange Method.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Selection List
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client uses and understands Variables of the SelectionListType VariableType.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client State Machine Instance
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use instances of the StateMachineType or a sub-type. Monitor either the CurrentState component Variable of the instance or the Events triggered as effect of state changes. Use Methods when defined for the StateMachineType to affect the state.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client System Status
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client makes use of SystemStatusChangeEventType to detect server shutdowns.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client System Status Underlying System
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client makes use of SystemStatusChangeEventType to detect changes to an Underlying System (SourceNode = Server).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client TemporaryFileTransferType Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can access a TemporaryFileTransferType Object either for reading or writing or both. This instance supports at least one of the following ConformanceUnits: - Base Info Client TemporaryFileTransfer Read - Base Info Client TemporaryFileTransfer Write

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client TemporaryFileTransferType Read
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can access a TemporaryFileTransferType Object to transfer Files from the Server to the Client. The Client is capable to transfer the Files to the Client whether a CompletionStateMachine is provided or not.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client TemporaryFileTransferType Write
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can access a TemporaryFileTransferType Object to transfer Files from the Client to the Server. The Client is capable to transfer the Files to the Server whether a CompletionStateMachine is provided or not.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Type Pre-Knowledge
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client shall interoperate with Servers that do not expose OPC UA Types in AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Client Type Programming
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client programmatically process instances of Objects or Variables by using their type definitions. This includes custom DataTypes, ObjectTypes and VariableTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info ContentFilter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ContentFilter DataType and its encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Controls
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType Controls and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Core Structure 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the base entry points Root and Objects and the Server Object with its base content ServerArray, NamespaceArray, ServerStatus, ServiceLevel, Auditing indication, entry point to VendorServerInfo and ServerRedundancy indication in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Core Types Folders
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes entry points into the type system in the AddressSpace. Specifically, these are the Folder Nodes: Types, ObjectTypes, DataTypes, VariableTypes, and ReferenceTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Core Views Folder
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the entry point into views in the AddressSpace. This is the Views Object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Currency
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the CurrencyUnit Property on DataVariables that represent currency.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Custom Type System
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports custom types (i.e. types that are derived from well-known ObjectTypes, VariableTypes, ReferenceTypes or DataTypes). Supporting this ConformanceUnit requires that the custom types with their full inheritance tree are exposed in the AddressSpace. For each DataType having encoding information (Structured DataTypes) the Encoding Objects shall be exposed as well. For all Events supported by the Server, the EventType shall be exposed.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Date DataTypes
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the DurationString, TimeString, and DateString DataTypes and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Decimal DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the DataType Decimal and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info DecimalString DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the DecimalString DataType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Deprecated Information
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ReferenceType IsDeprecated and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Device Failure
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports generating DeviceFailureEventType indicating changes to individual devices in an underlying system.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Diagnostics
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the collection of diagnostic information and exposes it in the AddressSpace. This includes always the ServerDiagnostics Object of the Server Object and its EnabledFlag Variable. The EnabledFlag in the ServerDiagnostics Object can be set TRUE and in that case the following Objects and Variables for diagnostic data as defined in the ServerDiagnosticsType are exposed: ServerDiagnosticsSummary with all its subcomponents, SubscriptionDiagnosticsArray, and SessionsDiagnosticsSummary with all its subcomponents.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Engineering Units
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports defining Variables that include the Engineering Units Property. This property makes use of the EUInformation data structure. This structure by default represents the UN/CEFACT "Codes for Units of Measurement". If a different EU representation is required then the EUInformation.namespaceUri will indicate the alternate namespace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Estimated Return Time
ConformanceUnit.Description: Server supports the EstimatedReturnTime Property. It indicates the time at which the Server is expected to have a ServerStatus.State of RUNNING_0. Clients can use this information to govern the reconnect logic.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info EUInformation
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the EUInformation DataType and its encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Event Processing
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client is able to subscribe for and process base OPC UA Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info EventQueueOverflow EventType
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the EventQueueOverflowEventType as defined for Monitoring Services.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Events Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the MaxSelectClauseParameters and MaxWhereClauseParameters of the ServerCapabilities Object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Export File Format
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the export of an address space using the defined export format.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info FileDirectoryType Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the FileDirectoryType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace and supports at least one instance of the FileDirectoryType or one of its subtypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info FileType Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the FileType Object. File writing may be restricted.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info FileType Write
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the FileType Object, including writing of files. Also included is the support of user access control on FileType Object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Finite State Machine Instance
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support instances of the FiniteStateMachineType or a sub-type in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Fixed SamplingInterval
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes diagnostic information on fixed sampling intervals (SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArray) when the Server is handling subscriptions with fixed sampling intervals and the EnabledFlag in the ServerDiagnostics Object is set to TRUE.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info GetMonitoredItems Method
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports obtaining subscription information via GetMonitoredItems Method on the Server object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Handle DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the Handle DataType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info HasAttachedComponent
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType HasAttachedComponent and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info HasContainedComponent
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType HasContainedComponent and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info HasOrderedComponent
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ReferenceType HasOrderedComponent and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info HasPhysicalComponent
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType HasPhysicalComponent and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info History Read Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposing the MaxHistoryContinuationPoints of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info History ReadData Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposing the MaxNodesPerHistoryReadData of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info History ReadEvents Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposing the MaxNodesPerHistoryReadEvents of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info History UpdateData Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposing the MaxNodesPerHistoryUpdateData of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info History UpdateEvents Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposing the MaxNodesPerHistoryReadEvents of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Image DataTypes
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the DataTypes Image, ImageBMP, ImageGIF, ImageJPG, ImagePNG and their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Import File Format
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the import of an address space used the defined file format.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info IsExecutableOn
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType IsExecutableOn and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info IsExecutingOn
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType IsExecutingOn and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info IsHostedBy
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType IsHostedBy and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info IsPhysicallyConnectedTo
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType IsPhysicallyConnectedTo and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info KeyValuePair
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the KeyValuePair DataType and its encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info LocalTime
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes local time information by providing the LocalTime Variable on the Server Object. Exposes the TimeZoneDataType, its Encoding Object and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info LocalTime Events
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the LocalTime event field on all Events provided by the Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Locations Object
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the entry point for different types of locations in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Method Argument DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the Argument DataType, its Encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Method Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the MaxNodesPerMethodCall of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Model Change
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the BaseModelChangeEvent and the NodeVersion Property for all Nodes that the Server allows model changes for.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Model Change General
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports GeneralModelChangeEvents including exposing the DataType ModelChangeStructureDataType and its Encoding Objects and the EventType GeneralModelChangeEventType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Namespace Metadata
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the NamespaceMetaData Object for all Namespaces in the Server that have static NodeIds.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Node Management Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the MaxNodesPerNodeManagement of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info NormalizedString DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the NormalizedString DataType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info OptionSet
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the VariableType OptionSetType.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info OptionSet DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the OptionSet DataType and its encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info OrderedList
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports ordered lists by exposing OrderedListType and IorderedObjectType, including all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info OrderedList Change Notification
ConformanceUnit.Description: At least one Instance of OrderedList or a Subtype exists in the Server and when the list changes, the NodeVersion changes and the GeneralModelChangeEvent is generated.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Placeholder Modelling Rules
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports defining custom Object or Variables that include the use of OptionalPlaceholder or MandatoryPlaceholder modelling rules.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Portable IDs
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports portable IDs by exposing the DataTypes PortableQualifiedName and PortableNodeId, their Encoding Objects and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Progress Events
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes if generation of Progress events for long running service calls such as HistoryRead is supported. If it is listed as supported in ServerCapabilities, then the actual events are verified.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Query Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the MaxQueryContinuationPoints of the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Range DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the Range DataType and its encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Rational Number
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the RationalNumberType and RationalNumber, all their supertypes and for the DataType the Encoding Objects in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info ReferenceDescription
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the VariableType ReferenceDescriptionVariableType, the ReferenceType HasReferenceDescription, the DataTypes ReferenceDescriptionDataType and ReferenceListEntryDataType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info RepresentsSameEntityAs
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType RepresentsSameEntityAs and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info RepresentsSameFunctionalityAs
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType RepresentsSameFunctionalityAs and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info RepresentsSameHardwareAs
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType RepresentsSameHardwareAs and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info RequestServerStateChange Method
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the RequestServerStateChange Method.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Requires
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the ReferenceType Requires and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info ResendData Method
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the standard Method ResendData to get the latest value of the monitored items of a Subscription.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Security Role Capabilities
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the the RoleSet Object on the ServerCapabilities Object in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Selection List
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports Variables of the SelectionListType VariableType.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info SemanticChange
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports SemanticChangeEvent for some Properties. This includes setting the SemanticChange Bit in the status when a semantic change occurs, such as a change in the engineering unit associated with a value.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info SemanticChange Bit
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports setting the SemanticsChanged Bit in the statusCode when a semantic change occurs, such as a change in the engineering unit associated with the Value Attribute.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info SemanticVersionString
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the SemanticVersionString DataType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Server Capabilities 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes ServerProfileArray, LocaleIdArray, MinSupportedSampleRate, MaxBrowseContinuationPoints, ModellingRules, MaxArrayLength, MaxStringLength, MaxByteStringLength and MaxSessions of the ServerCapabilities Object, as well as MaxNodesPerRead, MaxNodesPerWrite, MaxNodesPerBrowse, MaxNodesPerRegisterNodes, MaxNodesPerTranslateBrowsePathsToNodesIds of the OperationLimits Object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Server Capabilities MaxMonitoredItemsQueueSize
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes MaxMonitoredItemsQueueSize of the ServerCapabilities Object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Server Capabilities Subscriptions
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes AggregateFunctions, MaxSubscriptions, MaxMonitoredItems, MaxSubscriptionsPerSession and MaxMonitoredItemsPerSubscription of the ServerCapabilities Object as well as MaxMonitoredItemsPerCall of the OperationLimits Object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info ServerType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the type information of the ServerType and its containing types in the AddressSpace, including all their supertypes. It includes the Encoding Objects for its DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Spatial Data
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes DataTypes and VariableTypes used to expose spatial information, that is, the VariableTypes VectorType, 3DvectorType, CartesianCoordinatesType, 3DcartesianCoordinatesType, OrientationType, 3DorientationType, FrameType, 3DframeType, and the DataTypes Vector, 3Dvector, CartesianCoordinates, 3DcartesianCoordinates, Orientation, 3Dorientation, Frame and 3Dframe including all their supertypes and for the DataTypes the Encoding Objects in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info State Machine DescriptionNodeIdDataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support ContinuousOptions in the CurrentState. It indicates possible next steps or actions that can be taken from the current state.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info State Machine Instance
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support instances of the StateMachineType or a sub-type in the AddressSpace. Generate Events when significant state changes occur. At least one GeneratesEvent Reference exists to define the Event(s) triggered on state changes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info StatusResult DataType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the StatusResult DataType and its encoding Objects and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info Subvariables of Structures
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ReferenceType HasStructuredComponent and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info System Status
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports generating SystemStatusChangeEventType indicating shutdown of the Server (SourceNode=Server).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info System Status Underlying System
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports generating SystemStatusChangeEventType indicating changes to an Underlying System (SourceNode = Server). This event can also be used to indicate that the OPC UA Server has underlying systems.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info TemporaryFileTransferType Async Read
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports GenerateFileForRead Method call providing a File with a CompletionStateMachine and the File can be transferred to the Client.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info TemporaryFileTransferType Async Write
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports GenerateFileForWrite Method call providing a File Object and the File Object can be written and the CloseAndCommit Method returns successful with a CompletionStateMachine and the CompletionStateMachine ends in the Idle state.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info TemporaryFileTransferType Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the TemporaryFileTransferType and the FileTransferStateMachineType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace and supports at least one instance of the TemporaryFileTransferType or one of its subtypes. This instance supports at least one of the following ConformanceUnits: - Base Info TemporaryFileTransfer Sync Read - Base Info TemporaryFileTransfer Async Read - Base Info TemporaryFileTransfer Sync Write - Base Info TemporaryFileTransfer Async Write

ConformanceUnit.Name: Base Info TemporaryFileTransferType Sync Read
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports GenerateFileForRead Method call providing a File without a CompletionStateMachine and the File can be transferred to the Client.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Administrative Access
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server and Client allow for appropriate restriction of access to administrative personnel. This includes multiple levels of administrative access on platforms that support multiple administrative roles (such as Windows or Linux).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Alarm Handling
ConformanceUnit.Description: A Server should restrict critical alarm functionality to users that have the appropriate rights to perform these actions. This would include disabling of alarms, shelving of alarms and generation of dialog messages. It would also include other security related functionality such maintaining appropriate timeouts for shelving and dialogs and preventing an overload of dialog messages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Alarm Handling Client

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Audit Events Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: Audit tracking system connects to a Server using a Secure Channel and under the appropriate administrative rights to allow access to Audit Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Program Access
ConformanceUnit.Description: Programs access shall be restricted to appropriate personnel. in addition the overall concurrent execution of programs shall be limit in such a mmaner that there execution can not overwhelm the other aspects of a system

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Random Numbers
ConformanceUnit.Description: All random numbers that are required for security use appropriate cryptographic library based random number generators.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Strict Message Handling
ConformanceUnit.Description: The application assures that messages that are illegally or incorrectly formed are rejected with appropriate error code or appropriate actions as specified in UA Part 4 and UA Part 6.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Best Practice – Timeouts
ConformanceUnit.Description: The user is able to configure reasonable timeouts for Secure Channels, sessions and subscriptions to limit Denial of Service and resource consumption issues (see UA Part 2 for additional details).

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateKeyAlgorithm_ECC-brainpoolP256r1
ConformanceUnit.Description: The non-twisted 256 or 384 bit curve described in http://www.faqs.org/rfcs/rfc5639.html. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big-endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 64 bytes or 96 bytes. An end entity Certificate shall use P256r1. A CA that issues end entity Certificates shall use P256r1. Other CAs may use P384r1.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateKeyAlgorithm_ECC-brainpoolP384r1
ConformanceUnit.Description: The non-twisted 384 or 512 bit curve described in http://www.faqs.org/rfcs/rfc5639.html. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 96 and 128 bytes. An end entity Certificate shall use P384r1. A CA that issues end entity Certificates shall use P384r1. Other CAs may use P512r1.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateKeyAlgorithm_ECC-curve25519
ConformanceUnit.Description: Curve25519 described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748. ECC public keys are a single coordinate. ECC coordinates are encoded as little endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures are 64 bytes and keys are 32 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateKeyAlgorithm_ECC-curve448
ConformanceUnit.Description: Curve448 described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748. ECC public keys are a single coordinate. ECC coordinates are encoded as little endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures are 114 bytes, EphemeralKeys are 56 bytes and the public key in Certificates is 57 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateKeyAlgorithm_ECC-nistP256
ConformanceUnit.Description: The P-256 or P-384 curve described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.186-4.pdf. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big-endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 64 bytes or 96 bytes. An end entity Certificate shall use P-256. A CA that issues end entity Certificates shall use P-256. Other CAs may use P-384.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateKeyAlgorithm_ECC-nistP384
ConformanceUnit.Description: The P-384 or P-521 curve described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.186-4.pdf. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big-endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 96 bytes or 128 bytes. An end entity Certificate shall use P-384. A CA that issues end entity Certificates shall use P-384. Other CAs may use P-521.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateKeyAlgorithm_RSA
ConformanceUnit.Description: The RSA algorithm described in http://www.faqs.org/rfcs/rfc3447.html.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateSignatureAlgorithm_ECDSA-SHA2-256
ConformanceUnit.Description:
ECC digital signature algorithm described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.186-4.pdf. The SHA2 algorithm is described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6234. The SHA2 algorithm length depends on the public key. The length shall be 256 or 384 bits.
The required Hash Algorithm is based on the Curve Size in bits as follows: SHA-256 if bits <= 256 SHA-384 if bits > 256 and <= 384

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateSignatureAlgorithm_ECDSA-SHA2-384
ConformanceUnit.Description:
ECC digital signature algorithm described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.186-4.pdf. The SHA2 algorithm is described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6234. The hash algorithm length depends on the public key. The length shall be at 384 or 521 bits.
The required Hash Algorithm is based on the Curve Size in bits as follows: SHA-384 if bits > 256 and <= 384 SHA-512 if bits > 384

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateSignatureAlgorithm_None
ConformanceUnit.Description: This algorithm does not apply.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateSignatureAlgorithm_PureEdDSA-25519
ConformanceUnit.Description: ECC digital signature algorithm Ed25519 described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8032.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateSignatureAlgorithm_PureEdDSA-448
ConformanceUnit.Description: ECC digital signature algorithm Ed448 described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8032.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateSignatureAlgorithm_RSA-PKCS15-SHA1
ConformanceUnit.Description: The RSA signature algorithm which is defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3447. The RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 scheme is used. The hash algorithm is SHA1 and is described in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3174. The URI is http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1. SHA1 was broken in 2017 so this algorithm should not be used. The SHA2 algorithm with 244, 256, 384 or 512 bits may be used instead of SHA1. The SHA2 algorithm is described in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6234.

ConformanceUnit.Name: CertificateSignatureAlgorithm_RSA-PKCS15-SHA2-256
ConformanceUnit.Description: The RSA signature algorithm which is defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3447. The RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 scheme is used. The hash algorithm is SHA2 with 256bits and is described in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6234. The SHA2 algorithm with 384 or 512 bits may be used instead of SHA2 with 256 bits. The URI is http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#rsa-sha256.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_ECC-brainpoolP256r1
ConformanceUnit.Description: The non-twisted 256 bit curve described in http://www.faqs.org/rfcs/rfc5639.html. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 64 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to RFC8422.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_ECC-brainpoolP384r1
ConformanceUnit.Description: The non-twisted 384 bit curve described in http://www.faqs.org/rfcs/rfc5639.html. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 96 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to RFC8422.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_ECC-curve25519
ConformanceUnit.Description: Curve25519 described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748. ECC public keys are a single coordinate. ECC coordinates are encoded as little endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures are 64 bytes and keys are 32 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_ECC-curve448
ConformanceUnit.Description: Curve448 described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748. ECC public keys are a single coordinate. ECC coordinates are encoded as little endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures are 114 bytes, EphemeralKeys are 56 bytes and the public key in Certificates is 57 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7748.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_ECC-nistP256
ConformanceUnit.Description: The P-256 curve described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.186-4.pdf. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 64 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to RFC8422.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_ECC-nistP384
ConformanceUnit.Description: The P-384 curve described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/FIPS/NIST.FIPS.186-4.pdf. ECC public key compression is not used. ECC coordinates are encoded as big endian integers padded with zeros. Signatures and keys are 96 bytes. The ECDHE shared secret is calculated according to RFC8422.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_None
ConformanceUnit.Description: No EphemeralKeys are used.

ConformanceUnit.Name: EphemeralKeyAlgorithm_RSADH
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Diffie-Hellman key negotiation algorithm defined in https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2631.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Annotations
ConformanceUnit.Description: Enters and retrieves Annotations of historical data. The retrieval is accomplished using the standard historical read raw functionality (ReadRawModifiedDetails). The entry uses the standard Historical Update (UpdateStructureDataDetails) functionality.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Browse

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Data Insert

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Event Inserts
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryUpdate Service to insert historical Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Event Replaces
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryUpdate Service to replace historical Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Event Updates
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryUpdate Service to update historical Events.

ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryRead Service to read historical Event data using the ReadEventDetails Structure.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Read Raw
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryRead Service to read raw historical data using the ReadRawModifiedDetails Structure (ReadModified Flag set to False).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Server Timestamp
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the ServerTimestamp (as well as the default SourceTimestamp), if it is provided by the Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Structure Data Delete
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryUpdate Service to delete historical data values for structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Structure Data Insert
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryUpdate Service to insert historical data values for structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Structure Data Raw
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryRead Service to read raw historical data using the ReadRawModifiedDetails Structure (ReadModified Flag set to False) for structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Structure Data Read Modified
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryRead Service to read modified structured historical data using the ReadRawModifiedDetails Structure (ReadModified Flag set to True).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Structure Data Replace
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryUpdate Service to replace historical data values for structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Structure Data Time Instance
ConformanceUnit.Description: Reads historical data at a specified instance in time for structured data. Using the ReadAtTimeDetails structure.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Structure Data Update
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the HistoryUpdate Service to update historical data values for structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Client Time Instance
ConformanceUnit.Description: Reads historical data at a specified instance in time using the ReadAtTimeDetails structure.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Delete Event
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports deleting of historical Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Delete Value
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports deleting historical values of Variables.

ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the retrieval of historical Events using the ReadEventDetails structure. This includes support for simple filtering of Events. The Event fields that are stored are server specific, but at least the mandatory fields of BaseEventType are required.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Insert Event
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports inserting historical Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Insert Value

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Modified Values
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports maintaining old values for historical data that have been updated and the retrieval of these values using the ReadRawModifiedDetails structure (ReadModified flag set to true).

ConformanceUnit.Description: General support for basic historical access, reading raw data using the ReadRawModifiedDetails structure. Where the time range is specified using a start time, stop time and number of values (a minimum of two of the three parameters shallbe provided) and the ReadModified flag is set to False.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Replace Event
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports replacing historical Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Replace Value
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports replacing historical values of Variables.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access ServerTimestamp
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports providing a ServerTimestamp (as well as the default SourceTimestamp).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Structured Data Delete

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Structured Data Insert
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports historical access for structured data. Inserting Structured data. Supporting the structure for an annotation is not considered supporting generic structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports maintaining old values for historical structured data that have been updated and the retrieval of these values. ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Structured Data Replace
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports replacing structured historical data. Supporting the structure for an annotation is not considered supporting generic structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Structured Data Time Instance

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Structured Data Update
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports historical access for structured data. Updates of existing data. Supporting the structure for an annotation is not considered supporting generic structured data.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Time Instance
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports reading historical data at a specified instance in time using the ReadAtTimeDetails structure.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Update Event
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports updating historical Events.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Historical Access Update Value
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports updating historical values of Variables.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Host Resolution – DNS Registration
ConformanceUnit.Description: The UA Application supports the following: 1. Dynamically update the user-configured host name and IP with the DNS Server per RFC 2136.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Host Resolution – DNS Server
ConformanceUnit.Description: The UA Application supports the following: 1. Query the DNS Server to resolve external IP addresses from Host names using a DNS resolver as described in RFC 1034.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Host Resolution – Local Host File
ConformanceUnit.Description: The UA Application supports the following as described in Host Table RFC 952: 1. Read the user-configured local “Hosts” file to resolve external IP addresses from Host names.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Host Resolution – mDNS
ConformanceUnit.Description: The UA Application supports the following as described in the mDNS RFC 6762: 1. Announce the user-configured host name and IP address and respond to host name queries using the mDNS protocol. 2. Use mDNS queries to resolve external IP addresses from Host names.

ConformanceUnit.Name: JSON Reversible Encoding
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support reversible JSON Encoding defined in UA Part 6. The JSON object includes all information necessary to convert it back into OPC UA structures of any language.

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyCredential Authentication Mechanism Client Support
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client shall support at least one of the ConformanceUnits identified by "KeyCredential ProfileURI - xyz".

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyCredential Authentication Mechanism Support
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server shall support at least one of the ConformanceUnits identified by "KeyCredential ProfileURI - xyz".

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyCredential ProfileURI - AMQP SASL Plain
ConformanceUnit.Description: This unit indicates support of the SASL PLAIN as authentication mechanism for AMQP. The KeyCredentialConfiguration ProfileUri is http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Authentication/amqp-sasl-plain.

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyCredential ProfileURI - MQTT UserName
ConformanceUnit.Description: This unit indicates support of UserName / Password as authentication mechanism for MQTT. The KeyCredentialConfiguration ProfileUri is http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Authentication/mqtt-username

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyCredential ProfileURI - UA transport with UserName
ConformanceUnit.Description: This unit indicates support of UserName / Password for OPC UA transports. The KeyCredentialConfiguration ProfileUri is http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Security/UserToken/Server/UserNamePassword.

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyDerivationAlgorithm_HKDF-SHA2-256
ConformanceUnit.Description: The HKDF pseudo-random function defined in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5869. The hash algorithm is SHA2 with 256 bits and is described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6234.

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyDerivationAlgorithm_HKDF-SHA2-384
ConformanceUnit.Description: The HKDF pseudo-random function defined in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5869 The hash algorithm is SHA2 with 384 bits and is described in http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6234.

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyDerivationAlgorithm_None
ConformanceUnit.Description: This algorithm does not apply.

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyDerivationAlgorithm_P-SHA1
ConformanceUnit.Description: The P_SHA-1 pseudo-random function defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4346. The URI is http://docs.oasis-open.org/ws-sx/ws-secureconversation/200512/dk/p_sha1. No known exploits exist when using SHA1 with P-SHA-1, however, SHA1 was broken in 2017 so use of this algorithm is not recommended.

ConformanceUnit.Name: KeyDerivationAlgorithm_P-SHA2-256
ConformanceUnit.Description: The P_SHA256 pseudo-random function defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5246. The URI is http://docs.oasis-open.org/ws-sx/ws-secureconversation/200512/dk/p_sha256.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObjecr SourceName
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the SourceName field in the LogRecord structure

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject AdditionalData
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports collecting and storing additional data in the AdditionalData value pair.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Provides support for the base concepts in a LogObject, this includes support for at least one instance of a LogObjectType and the mandatory fields in the LogRecordStructure.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject Base Event Collection
ConformanceUnit.Description: Provides support for collecting LogRecords from events that are generated with the class identifier of LogEntryConditionClassType. This includes being able to store the EventType, SourceNode, and SourceName in a LogRecord.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject Event Generation
ConformanceUnit.Description: Provides support for generating Events for LogRecords that have been received by the LogObject (outside of receiving an event).

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject EventType
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports the EventType field in the LogRecord Structure

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject Logs Folder
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the Logs Folder including all required behaviour.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject MaxRecords
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the LogObject optional Property MaxRecords and provides support for limiting the size of the LogRecord storage by MaxRecords as defined in the specification.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject MaxStorageDuration
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the LogObject optional Property MaxStorageDuration and provides support for limiting the size of the LogRecord storage by MaxStorageDuration as defined in the specification.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject MinimumSeverity
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the LogObject optional Property MinimumSeverity, including the ability to update the value.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject Persistent Storage
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support persisting LogRecords through a power outage.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject ServerLog
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ServerLog Object, including all required behaviour.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject SourceNode
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports SourceNode field in LogRecord Structures

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject Storage Overflow
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports generating the LogOverflowEventType as described in the specification.

ConformanceUnit.Name: LogObject TraceContext
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports receiving and generating the TraceContext information for LogRecords.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Method Call
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the Call Service to call (invoke) a Method which includes support for Method Parameters.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Method Call Complex
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support Methods with arguments that have structured DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Method Client Call
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Call Service to call one or several Methods.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Method Client Call Complex
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Call Service for Methods with arguments that have structured DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Method Client Call SessionLess
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Call Service to call one or several Methods with the SessionLessInvoke Service.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Method Client Call with Optional Arguments
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Call Service to call one or several Methods having optional input arguments.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Minimum Client Functionality
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client as a minimum shall provide one or more of the following Facets to * Lookup the AddressSpace (requires Browse Service) * Reading Attributes * Writing Attributes * Use Subscriptions to monitor Attribute Values * Use Subscriptions to monitor Events * Invoke Methods

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Aggregate Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support for Aggregate filters for MonitoredItems. The result of this ConformanceUnit includes a list of Aggregates that are supported as part of the Profile Certificate.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Alternate Encoding
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support alternate encoding when monitoring value Attributes. By default, every Server has to support the encoding of the currently used Stack Profile (i.e. binary with UA Binary Encoding and XML with XML Encoding). This ConformanceUnit - when supported - specifies that the other encoding is supported in addition.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Basic
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the following MonitoredItem Services: CreateMonitoredItems, ModifyMonitoredItems, DeleteMonitoredItems and SetMonitoringMode.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client AbsoluteDeadband Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses Absolute Deadband filters for subscriptions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Aggregate Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses Aggregate filters for Subscriptions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client by Index
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the IndexRange to select a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is an array.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client ByteString by Index
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the IndexRange to select a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is a ByteString.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Complex Event Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use of the 'OfType' complex Event filter operator.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Complex Value
ConformanceUnit.Description: Monitor and decode Values with structured DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Event Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Event filter when calling CreateMonitoredItems to filter the desired Events and to select the columns to be provided for each Event Notification.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Events
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the MonitoredItem Service Set to create MonitoredItems for Event notifications.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Modify
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use ModifyMonitoredItems Service to change the configuration setting. Use SetMonitoringMode Service to disable / enable sampling and / or publishing.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client PercentDeadband Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses Percent Deadband filters for subscriptions as defined in UA Part 8.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Queue Greater than 1
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the QueueSize parameter with a value to queue multiple samples for a Monitored item. If it supports ModifyMonitoredItems, it can also modify the QueueSize. Also the Client respects the order of the queued notifications.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client String by Index
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the IndexRange to select a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is a String.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Trigger
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Triggering Model if certain items are to be reported only if some other item triggers. Use proper monitoring mode for these items. Use SetTriggering Service to link these items to the trigger item.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Client Value Change
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the MonitoredItem Service Set to register items for changes in Attribute value. Use CreateMonitoredItems to register the Node/Attribute tuple. Set proper sampling interval and queuing mode. Use disabling / enabling instead of deleting and re-creating a MonitoredItem. Use bulk operations rather than individual service requests to reduce communication overhead.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Complex Event Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support for the 'OfType' complex Event filter operator.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Complex Value
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports monitoring and encoding Values with structured DataTypes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Events
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support creation of MonitoredItems for an "EventNotifier Attribute" for the purpose of Event Notification. The subscription includes supporting a filter that includes SimpleAttribute Operands and a select list of Operators. The list of Operators includes: Equals, IsNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanorEqual, LessThatorEqual, Like, Not, Between, InList, And, Or, Cast, BitwiseAnd, BitwiseOr.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Items 10
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 10 MonitoredItems per Subscription where the size of each MonitoredItem is at least equal to size of Double.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Items 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 2 MonitoredItems per Subscription where the size of each MonitoredItem is at least equal to size of Double.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Items 500
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 500 MonitoredItems per Subscription. This number has to be supported for at least half of the required Subscriptions for half of the required Sessions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor MinQueueSize_05
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 5 queue entries for MonitoredItems. Servers often will adapt the queue size to the number of currently MonitoredItems. However, it is expected that Servers support this minimum queue size for at least one third of the supported MonitoredItems.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Queueing
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 2 queue entries for MonitoredItems. Servers often will adapt the queue size to the number of currently monitored Items. It is expected that Servers support the documented queue capacity for at least one third of the supported MonitoredItems.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor QueueSize_ServerMax
ConformanceUnit.Description: This ConformanceUnit is for events. When the Client requests queuesize=MAXUInt32 the Server is to return the maximum queue size that it can support for event notifications as the revisedQueueSize.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Triggering
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the SetTriggering Service to create and/or delete triggering links for a triggering item.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Monitor Value Change V2
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support creation of MonitoredItems for Attribute value changes. This includes support of the IndexRange to select a single element or a range of elements when the Attribute value is an array. ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Connection PublisherId

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Connection State

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Create PublishedDataItems DataSet
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports creating a PublishedDataItems DataSet by specifying an array of Variables to add. The Publisher also supports creating a PublishedDataItems DataSet by specifying DataSetMetaData as template and an array of Variables that matches the template.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Create PublishedDataSet
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports creation of at least one kind of PublishedDataSet.

ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports creating a PublishedEvents DataSet by specifying an event filter. The Publisher also supports creating a PublishedEvents DataSet by specifying DataSetMetaData as template and an event filter where the selected fields match the template.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Cyclic Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports at least one of the following ConformanceUnits that define cyclic limits. Support is required with all of the supported optional settings including Security (signing and/or encryption).

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSet Configuration Change
ConformanceUnit.Description: If the Publisher supports online configuration changes, it shall also support sending the meta data updates for these changes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSet ExtensionFields
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher can be configured with extension fields which can be included in Published DataSets.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSet Folder
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher can be configured to organize Published DataSets in Folders. If the Publisher is a UA Server, these Folders will be exposed in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSetWriter FieldEncoding
ConformanceUnit.Description: DataSetWriter can be configured to encode DataSet fields as DataValue, Variant, or RawData. This parameter is mandatory when using a header layout other than Cyclic-Fixed.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSetWriter JSON DataSetMsgContentMask
ConformanceUnit.Description: Publisher supports configuration of the DataSetMessageContentMask.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSetWriter KeyFrameCount
ConformanceUnit.Description: DataSetWriter can be configured with a KeyFrameCount. This parameter is mandatory when using a header layout other than Cyclic-Fixed.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSetWriter State
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports enabling or disabling of DataSetWriters.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSetWriter UADP ConfiguredSize
ConformanceUnit.Description: Publisher supports configuration of a fixed size for a DataSetMessage (“ConfiguredSize”).

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher DataSetWriter UADP DataSetMsgContentMask
ConformanceUnit.Description: Publisher supports configuration of the DataSetMessageContentMask.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Diagnostics
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports instances of PubSub DiagnosticsType and the subtypes appropriate for the Publisher as defined in UA Part 14.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Information Model
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher is an OPC UA Server and exposes its configuration to OPC UA Clients using the OPC UA PubSub Information Model.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Key Server Access
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher is able to fetch the security keys by calling the GetSecurityKeys Method on a remote Key Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher MetaData Discovery Option On Request
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports discovery of meta data by listening for discovery request messages and sending the discovery response.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher MetaData Discovery Option Periodic
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports discovery of configuration and meta data by periodically sending unsolicited discovery response messages. The period shall be configurable and it shall be possible to disable the periodic sending.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher MetaData Discovery Option Queue
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports discovery of meta data by sending the meta data to a separate, permanent MessageQueue.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Modify PublishedDataSet
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports modification of configured PublishedDataSets. For a PublishedDataItems DataSet this includes support of the AddVariables/RemoveVariables Methods. For a PublishedEvents DataSet it includes support of the ModifyFieldSelection Method.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Remove Connection
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports removing PubSub Connections.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Remove DataSetWriter
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports removing DataSetWriters.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Remove PublishedDataSet
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports deletion of a configured PublishedDataSets.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Remove WriterGroup
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports removing WriterGroups.

ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher uses security keys to sign and encrypt messages before publishing. The security keys may be fetched from a remote Key Server or the Publisher itself is a KeyServer in which case it has to support the KeyServer Facet.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Security Key Handling2
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher uses security keys to sign and / or encrypt messages before publishing. ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher Set WriterGroup State
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports enabling or disabling of WriterGroups.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher SetSecurityKeys
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports the SetSecurityKeys Method to accept a pushed key from the SKS.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP chunking

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP Defined Ordering
ConformanceUnit.Description: If more than one DataSetMessage can be included in a single NetworkMessage the Publisher has to implement a defined DataSetOrdering,

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP Delta Frames
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports sending delta frames when only a subset of the DataSet fields change.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP Dynamic Data or Events Settings

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP Flexible Settings

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP Periodic Fixed Settings
ConformanceUnit.Description: Publisher supports encoding NetworkMessages and DataSetMessages with UADP Message headers for periodic data with fixed layout (http://opcfoundation.org/UA/PubSub-Layouts/UADP-Periodic-Fixed). ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP PublisherId UInt16

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP PublisherId UInt64
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Publisher supports PublisherId of Type UInt64 in UADP NetworkMessages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher UADP Security Encryption

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher WriterGroup KeepAliveTime
ConformanceUnit.Description: WriterGroups can be configured with a KeepAliveTime.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher WriterGroup LocaleIds
ConformanceUnit.Description: WriterGroups can be configured with LocaleIds.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher WriterGroup Priority

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher WriterGroup PublishingInterval

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Publisher WriterGroup Security

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber 2 NetworkMessages acyclic 4096 bytes
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports processing two separate NetworkMessages and four DataSetMessages. The DataSetMessages can be flexibly assigned to the two NetworkMessages.
