ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports processing two separate NetworkMessages and four DataSetMessages. The DataSetMessages can be flexibly assigned to the two NetworkMessages. E.g. each Networkmessage with two DataSetMessages or one NetworkMessage with four DataSetMessages. The messages will be received acyclic. The minimum supported DataSet payload shall be 512 bytes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Acyclic Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports at least one of the following ConformanceUnits that define acyclic imits. Support is required with all of the supported optional settings including Security (signing and/or encryption).

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Add Connection
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports creating new PubSub Connections.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Add DataSetReader
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports creating new DataSetReaders to a group.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Add ReaderGroup
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports creating new ReaderGroups to a PubSub Connection.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Broker RequestedDeliveryGuarantee
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of the delivery guarantees that a DataSetReader negotiates with a Broker for all messages received.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Connection Address
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports modifying the Connection address by writing to the corresponding Variable.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Connection Datagramm DiscoveryAddress
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of a DiscoveryAddress. This address information used for the discovery request and response messages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Connection State
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports enabling or disabling of PubSub Connections.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Cyclic Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports at least one of the following ConformanceUnits that define cyclic imits. Support is required with all of the supported optional settings including Security (signing and/or encryption).

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSet Configuration Change
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber monitors the version information in messages (ConfigurationVersion or GroupVersion) and takes proper action to request and/or apply the related meta data whenever the version changes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader DataSetMetaData
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports setting DataSetMetaData for DataSetReaders.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader DataSetMirror
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports DataSetMirror as SubscribedDataSetType.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader DataSetWriterId Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports setting a DataSetWriterId filter for a DataSetReader.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader FieldEncoding
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber can be configured to decode DataSet fields as DataValue, Variant, or RawData.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader JSON DataSetMsgContentMask
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of optional header fields included in received DataSetMessages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader JSON NetworkMsgContentMask
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of optional header fields included in received NetworkMessages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader MessageReceiveTimeout
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports setting a MessageReceiveTimeout for a DataSetReader. It defines the maximum acceptable time between two DataSetMessages..

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader PublisherId Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports setting a PublisherId filter for a DataSetReader.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader State
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports enabling or disabling of DataSetReaders.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader TargetVariables
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports TargetVariables as SubscribedDataSetType.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader UADP DataSetClassId Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports setting a DataSetClassId filter for a DataSetReader.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader UADP DataSetMsgContentMask
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of optional header fields included in received DataSetMessages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader UADP DataSetOffset
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of a DataSetOffset inside the NetworkMessage.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader UADP GroupVersion Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of the expected GroupVersion.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader UADP NetworkMsgContentMask
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of optional header fields included in received NetworkMessages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader UADP ProcessingOffset
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of the offset in the PublishingInterval cycle when the received DataSetMessage must be processed.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader UADP ReceiveOffset
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports configuration of the offset in the PublishingInterval cycle for receiving a DataSetMessage.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber DataSetReader WriterGroupId Filter
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports setting a WriterGroupId filter for a DataSetReader.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Diagnostics
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports instances of PubSub DiagnosticsType and the subtypes appropriate for the Subscriber in UA Part 14.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Information Model
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber is an OPC UA Server and exposes its configuration to OPC UA Clients using the OPC UA PubSub Information Model.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Key Server Access
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber is able to fetch the security keys by calling the GetSecurityKeys Method on a remote Key Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber MetaData Discovery Option Periodic
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports processing meta data received with unsolicited discovery response messages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber MetaData Discovery Option Queue
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports discovery of meta data by reading them from a separate, permanent MessageQueue as described.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber MetaData Discovery Option Request
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports discovery of meta data by sending a discovery request message and processing the meta data in the discovery response message. Such a request shall be sent only if the Subscriber receives messages and has no meta data with matching version information.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber ReaderGroup MaxNetworkMessageSize
ConformanceUnit.Description: ReaderGroups in the Subscriber can be configured with a MaxNetworkMessageSize.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber ReaderGroup Set Security
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports a SecurityMode other than None and allows setting the SecurityGroupId Parameter and the SecurityKeyServices Parameter.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber ReaderGroup State
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports enabling or disabling of ReaderGroups.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Remove Connection
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports removing PubSub Connections.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Remove DataSetReader
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports removing DataSetReaders.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Remove ReaderGroup
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports removing ReaderGroups.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Security Key Handling
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber uses security keys to check signatures and decrypt received messages. The security keys may be fetched from a remote Key Server in which case the Publisher has to support the SessionLess Client Profile to invoke the GetSecurityKeys Method.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber Security Key Handling2
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber uses security keys to check signatures and / or decrypt received messages. The security keys may be fetched using the GetSecurityKeys Method, or pushed using the SetSecurityKeys Method.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber SetSecurityKeys
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports the SetSecurityKeys Method to accept a pushed key from the SKS.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP chunking
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports decoding large, chunked DataSetMessages.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP Delta Frames
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber can decode and process delta frames of a published DataSet.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP Dynamic Data or Events Settings
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports decoding NetworkMessages and DataSetMessages with UADP Message headers for Events and Data with dynamic layout (http://opcfoundation.org/UA/PubSub-Layouts/UADP-Dynamic). If signing is supported, the layout variant for integrity shall be supported also. If encryption is supported, the layout variant for confidentiality and integrity shall be supported also.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP Flexible Settings
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports decoding of UADP messages with all legal combinations of optional NetworkMessage and DatasetMessage header fields. Support all Dataset field encodings.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP Periodic Fixed Settings
ConformanceUnit.Description: Subscriber supports decoding NetworkMessages and DataSetMessages with UADP Message headers for periodic data with fixed layout (http://opcfoundation.org/UA/PubSub-Layouts/UADP-Periodic-Fixed). If signing is supported, the layout variant for integrity shall be supported also. If encryption is supported, the layout variant for confidentiality and integrity shall be supported also.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP Periodic Fixed Settings2
ConformanceUnit.Description: All PublisherId types defined for periodic data with fixed layout shall be supported.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP Security Decryption
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Subscriber supports signature checking and message decryption. Implies the functionality of the "PubSub Subscriber UADP Security Signature" ConformanceUnit.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub Subscriber UADP Security Signature
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least PubSub Security Policy [A] for checking the signature in signed messages. Support of multiple Security Policies - even obsolete ones - is recommended. This will provide best interoperability and allows the end user to choose the required level of security. Obsolete Security Policies shall not be enabled / usable without administrative intervention.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub UADP Message Mapping
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support UADP message mapping defined in UA Part 14.

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub-Aes128-CTR_Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: -> SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm Key Length: 256 bits -> SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm Key Length: 128 bits -> SymmetricEncryption Nonce Length: 4 Byte

ConformanceUnit.Name: PubSub-Aes256-CTR_Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: -> SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm Key Length: 256 bits -> SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm Key Length: 256 bits -> SymmetricEncryption Nonce Length: 4 Byte

ConformanceUnit.Name: Pull Model for Global Certificate and TrustList Management
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Certificate Management Services of UA Part 12 for the Pull model to manage Application Instance Certificates and Trust Lists including Revocation Lists.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Pull Model for KeyCredential Service
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Methods on an instance of the KeyCredentialServiceType (Pull model) to obtain KeyCredentials as specified in UA Part 12.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Push Model for Global Certificate and TrustList Management
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the Certificate Management Services of UA Part 12 for the Push model to manage Application Instance Certificates and Trust Lists including Revocation Lists.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Push Model for KeyCredential Service
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the KeyCredential Services Push model of UA Part 12 to obtain KeyCredentials. This includes support of one or more instances of the KeyCredentialConfigurationType and the Methods to update or delete credentials.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Alias
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support "alias" in filters.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Basic
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the QueryFirst and QueryNext Services and a basic query model. This includes support for basic content filter, this includes only the simple operators.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Client Alias
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client uses alias structure in its filters.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Client Basic
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client uses simple query calls.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Client RelatedTo
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client uses the feature available with an advanced query Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Client RelatedTo Multi-Hop
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client uses the features available with an advanced query Server including multiple-hop RelatedTo operators.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Minimum 2 continuation point
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least two continuation points for the Query Service.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query Minimum 5 continuation point
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least five continuation points for the Query Service.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query RelatedTo Muli-Hop
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the list of advanced query operators including multiple hop RelatedTo operators.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Query RelatedTo Operator
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the list of advanced query operators, include RelatedTo operator for a single hop.

ConformanceUnit.Name: ReadSafetyData
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exchange of safety protocol data units using a method.

ConformanceUnit.Name: ReadSafetyDiagnostics
ConformanceUnit.Description: A diagnostic interface to a SafetyProvider and its communication with a SafetyConsumer.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Redundancy Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: Client supports Client redundancy. Clients that support Client redundancy can failover to another Client (requires some out of band communication).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Redundancy Client Switch
ConformanceUnit.Description: Clients supporting this ConformanceUnit monitor the redundancy status for non-transparent redundancy Servers and switch to the backup Server when they recognize a change in server status.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Redundancy Server
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports Server based redundancy.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Redundancy Server Transparent
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports transparent Server redundancy.

ConformanceUnit.Name: RSADH-AesGcm_Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: -> DerivedSignatureKeyLength = 0 bits -> EncryptionKeyLength = 128 bits -> InitializationVectorLength = 96 bits -> SignatureLength = 128 bits -> MinAsymmetricKeyLength = 2048 bits (RSA) -> MaxAsymmetricKeyLength = 4096 bits (RSA) -> SecureChannelNonceLength = 256 bytes (ffdhe2048), 384 bytes (ffdhe3072), 512 bytes (ffdhe4096)

ConformanceUnit.Name: RSADH-ChaChaPoly_Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: -> DerivedSignatureKeyLength = 0 -> EncryptionKeyLength=256 -> InitializationVectorLength=96 -> SignatureLength=128 -> MinAsymmetricKeyLength = 2048 (RSA) -> MaxAsymmetricKeyLength = 4096 (RSA) -> SecureChannelNonceLength = 256 (ffdhe2048), 384 (ffdhe3072), 512 (ffdhe4096)

ConformanceUnit.Name: Safety Consumer
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports SafetyConsumer that implements the data sink of a unidirectional safety link (see Part 15).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Safety Provider
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports SafetyProvider that implements the data source of a unidirectional safety link (see Part 15). This includes an instance of the SafetyProviderType.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyACSet
ConformanceUnit.Description: An entry point for browsing a component implementing OPC UA Safety and finding its SafetyProviders and/or SafetyConsumers.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyConsumerBehavior
ConformanceUnit.Description: Implement the SafetyConsumer behavior.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyConsumerParameters
ConformanceUnit.Description: An interface to query the parameters of a SafetyConsumer.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyPDUs
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exchange of safety protocol data units using OPC UA variables.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyPDUs Publisher
ConformanceUnit.Description: Publish safety protocol data units using OPC UA variables.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyPDUs Subscriber
ConformanceUnit.Description: Consume safety protocol data units.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyProviderBehavior
ConformanceUnit.Description: Implement the SafetyProvider behavior.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyProviderMapper
ConformanceUnit.Description: An abstract conformance unit representing a mapper for the SafetyProvider. Support at least one of SafetyProviderServerMapper or SafetyProviderPubSubMapper.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetyProviderParameters
ConformanceUnit.Description: An interface to query the parameters of a SafetyProvider.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SafetySupport
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least one of SafetyProvider Facet or SafetyConsumer Facet.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Scheduler Calendar Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ObjectType CalendarType, the DataTypes CalendarEntryType, DateType, Month, DayOfMonth, DayOfWeek, and DateRangeType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace. Supports a configuration with at least three instances of CalendarType, each having at least 10 entries in DateList.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Scheduler Calendar Configuration
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports at least on instance of CalendarType supporting the Methods AddDateListElements and RemoveDateListElements to change the DateList Property.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Scheduler Client Configuration
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client supports the configuration of instances of ScheduleType and CalendarType, by changing the configuration of existing Objects.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Scheduler Scheduling Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the ObjectType ScheduleType, the DataTypes SpecialEventType, SpecialEventPeriodType, CalendarEntryType, DateType, Month, DayOfMonth, DayOfWeek, DateRangeType, TimeActionsType, BaseActionType, WriteLocalVariableActionType, CallLocalMethodActionType, TimeType and DailyScheduleType and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace. Supports a configuration with at least two instances of ScheduleType having at least 12 entries of DaySchedule in their WeeklySchedule (overall, not per day), and 6 entries in the ExceptionSchedule each having at least 6 entries of ListOfTimeActions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Scheduler Scheduling Configuration
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports at least on instance of ScheduleType supporting the Methods AddExceptionScheduleElements and RemoveExceptionScheduleElements to change the ExceptionSchedule Property and allowing writing the WeeklySchedule Property.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security – No Application Authentication
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports being able to be configured for no application authentication, just User authentication and normal encryption/signing: – Configure Server to skip the trust check when validating certificates – Certificates are just used for message security (signing and encryption) – Users level is used for authentication

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Administration
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow configuration of the following Security related items (when they apply). * select the allowed/used User identification policy or policies (e.g. User Name/Password or X509). * enable/disable or select the security policy "None" or other security policies. * enable/disable or select endpoints with MessageSecurityMode SIGN or SIGNANDENCRYPT. * set the permitted certification authorities. * define how to react to unknown Certificates. * allow accepting any valid Certificate

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Certificate Administration
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow a site administrator to be able to assign a site specific ApplicationInstanceCertificate and if desired to configure a site specific Certificate Authority (CA).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Certificate Validation
ConformanceUnit.Description: A certificate will be validated as specified in UA Part 4. This includes among others structure and signature examination. Allowing for some validation errors to be suppressed by administration directive.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Default ApplicationInstance Certificate
ConformanceUnit.Description: An application, when installed, has a default ApplicationInstanceCertificate that is valid. The default ApplicationInstanceCertificate shall either be created as part of the installation or installation instructions explicitly describe the process to create and apply a default ApplicationInstanceCertificate to the application.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security ECC Policy
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support one of SecurityPolicy [ECC-A] or SecurityPolicy [ECC-B] which are suitable for devices with limited resources. It is recommended that both Security Policies be supported to increase interoperability and provide a fallback if an algorithm is compromised.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Encryption Required
ConformanceUnit.Description: Encryption is required using the algorithms provided in the security algorithm suite.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Invalid user token
ConformanceUnit.Description: Servers shall take proper measures to protect against attacks on user identity tokens. Such an attack is assumed if repeated connection attempts with invalid user identity tokens happen. See ActivateSession Service in UA Part 4.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security LegacySequenceNumber
ConformanceUnit.Description: LegacySequenceNumbers set to TRUE.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security LegacySequenceNumber False
ConformanceUnit.Description: LegacySequenceNumbers set to False.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security None CreateSession ActivateSession
ConformanceUnit.Description: When SecurityPolicy=None, the CreateSession and ActivateSession service allow for a NULL/empty signature and do not require Application Certificates or a Nonce.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security None CreateSession ActivateSession 1.0
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can connect to Servers that require a Certificate being passed on Session establishment. The Client in this case will first try without a Certificate and if this fails present a Certificate.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Policy Required
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least Security Policy [A] and Security Policy [B]. Support of multiple Security Policies - even obsolete ones - is recommended. This will provide best interoperability and allows the end user to choose the required level of security. Obsolete Security Policies shall not be enabled / usable without administrative intervention.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Client Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Understand and use the User Authorization Information Model defined in UA Part "Role Based Security" and the RolePermissions Attribute.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Client DefaultRolePermissions
ConformanceUnit.Description: Ability to set the DefaultRolePermissions Property for certain NameSpaces. DefaultRolePermissions are applied if no RolePermissions are associated with a Node.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Client Management
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support creating new Roles and adding Identities as well as remove Roles or Identities using the appropriate Methods.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Client Restrict Applications
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the appropriate Methods to add applications to a Role so that only these applications can use this Role.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Client Restrict Endpoints
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the appropriate Methods to add Endpoints to a Role. With this restriction a Role is only applied when a Client connects via one of these Endpoints.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Client RolePermissions
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support setting the RolePermissions Attribute on Nodes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Client User Management
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support managing users using the proper Methods on the "UserManagement" Object.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server ApplicationManagement
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow authorized users to add and/or remove Applications from Roles with the AddApplication/RemoveApplication Methods.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server Authorization
ConformanceUnit.Description: Restrict access based on the configured Roles and permissions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server Base 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the User Authorization Information Model like Roles and the RolePermissions, UserRolePermissions, and AccessRestrictions Attributes. Includes exposing AccessRestrictionType and RolePermissionType and their encoding Objects and all their supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server Base Eventing
ConformanceUnit.Description: Exposes the RoleMappingRuleChangedAuditEventType EventType and all its supertypes in the AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server DefaultRolePermissions
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow authorized users to set the DefaultRolePermissions Property for certain NameSpaces. DefaultRolePermissions are applied if no RolePermissions are associated with a Node.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server EndpointManagement
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow authorized users to add and/or remove Endpoints from Roles with the AddEndpoint/RemoveEndpoint Methods.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server IdentityManagement
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow authorized users to add and/or remove Identities from Roles with the AddIdentity/RemoveIdentity Methods.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server Management
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow authorized users to create new Roles and/or remove Roles with the appropriate Methods.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server Restrict Applications
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support adding applications to a Role with the appropriate Methods so that only these applications can use this Role.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server Restrict Endpoints
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support adding Endpoints to a Role with the appropriate Methods. With this restriction a Role is only applied when a Client connects via one of these Endpoints.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Server RolePermissions
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow authorized users to set the RolePermissions Attribute on Nodes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role TrustedApplication
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the well-known Role "TrustedApplication" with suggested permissions defined in UA Parts "AddressSpace Model" and "Role-Based Security".

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Well Known
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the well-known Roles "ConfigureAdmin" and "SecurityAdmin" with suggested permissions defined in UA Parts "AddressSpace Model" and "Role Based Security"..

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Well Known Group 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the well-known Roles "Anonymous" and "AuthenticatedUser" with suggested permissions defined in UA Parts "AddressSpace Model" and "Role-Based Security".

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security Role Well Known Group 3
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the well-known Roles "Observer", “Engineer”, “Supervisor”, and "Operator" with suggested permissions defined in UA Parts "AddressSpace Model" and "Role-Based Security".

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security SecureChannelEnhancements True
Security Signing Required
ConformanceUnit.Description: Signing is required using the algorithms provided in the security algorithm suite.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security TLS 1.1
ConformanceUnit.Description: The connection is established using TLS 1.1. The application shall be configured to prevent TLS 1.0 connections, unless the TLS 1.0 connection is using TLS_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA as described in ConformanceUnit "Security TLS_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA"

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security TLS General
ConformanceUnit.Description: This ConformanceUnit indicates that at least one of the transport security Profiles for TLS is supported by this application. It is used in TLS transport Profiles, but the choice of transport security profile is optional. The actual used security profile will default to the most secure one.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security TLS_DHE_RSA with AES_nnn_CBC_SHA256
ConformanceUnit.Description: The connection is established using TLS_DHE_RSA with AES_128_CBC_SHA256 or TLS_DHE_RSA with AES_256_CBC_SHA256. That has a MinAsymmetricKeyLength – 2048, MaxAsymmetricKeyLength – 4096, CertificateSignatureAlgorithm – RSA_SHA256. (TLS 1.2). Clients and Servers have to support both algorithms.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security TLS_RSA with AES_256_CBC_SHA256
ConformanceUnit.Description: The connection is established using TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256. That has a MinAsymmetricKeyLength – 2048, MaxAsymmetricKeyLength – 4096, AsymmetricSignatureAlgorithm – RSA_SHA256. (TLS 1.2)

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security TLS_RSA with RC4_128_SHA
ConformanceUnit.Description: The connection is established using TLS_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA. The application shall be configured to prevent the use of AES based protocol suites (TLS 1.0).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Anonymous
ConformanceUnit.Description: The UA application (Client or Server) supports the Anonymous User Identity Token. Servers shall allow administrators to disable/enable this token. Clients should allow administrators to disable/enable this token.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Anonymous Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: The UA Client supports the Anonymous User Identity Token. Clients should allow administrators to disable/enable this token.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Anonymous Server
ConformanceUnit.Description: The UA Server supports the Anonymous User Identity Token. Servers shall allow administrators to disable/enable this token.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Identity Token Support
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least one of the optional Conformance Units that represent User Identity Token support (User Name/Password, User X.509, User JWT IssuedToken, ...). In case the Server support different kinds of User Identity tokens, the administrator shall be able to enable or disable individual tokens.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User IssuedToken Kerberos
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports a Kerberos Server token for User Identity. The use of this feature shall be able to be enabled or disabled by an Administrator. The use of this token is defined in Kerberos Token Documentation. The token will be encrypted if required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint. An unencrypted token either requires message encryption or means outside the scope of OPC UA to secure the identity token so that it cannot be retrieved by sniffing the communication. One option would be a secure transport like a VPN.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User IssuedToken Kerberos Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: A Client uses a Kerberos Server token. The use of this token is defined by the Kerberos documentation. The token will be encrypted if required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint. An unencrypted token either requires message encryption or means outside the scope of OPC UA to secure the identity token so that it cannot be retrieved by sniffing the communication. One option would be a secure transport like a VPN.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User IssuedToken Kerberos Windows
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports the Windows implementation of Kerberos Tokens. This ConformanceUnit only applies if the "Security User IssuedToken Kerberos" is supported. The token will be encrypted if required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint. An unencrypted token either requires message encryption or means outside the scope of OPC UA to secure the identity token so that it cannot be retrieved by sniffing the communication. One option would be a secure transport like a VPN.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User IssuedToken Kerberos Windows Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: A Client uses the Windows implementation of Kerberos tokens. This ConformanceUnit only applies if the "Security User IssuedToken Kerberos Client" is supported. The token will be encrypted if required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint. An unencrypted token either requires message encryption or means outside the scope of OPC UA to secure the identity token so that it cannot be retrieved by sniffing the communication. One option would be a secure transport like a VPN.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User JWT IssuedToken 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports a JSON Web Token (JWT) for user identity. UA Part 6 describes OAuth2 and JWTs in more detail. The use of this feature shall be able to be enabled or disabled by an Administrator. The token will be encrypted if required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User JWT IssuedToken 2 Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: A Client uses a JSON Web Token (JWT) for user identity. UA Part 6 describes OAuth2 and JWTs in more detail. The token will be encrypted if required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User JWT Token Policy
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports one or more Endpoints with a UserTokenPolicy that includes a JWT IssuerEndpointUrl as defined in UA Part 6. For JWT the issuerEndpointUrl is a JSON object that includes all parameters that define the AuthorizationService. As part of the JWT Token Policy, the Server shall support at least one of the following Authority Profile ConformanceUnits. The URIs defined in the ConformanceUnit shall be exposed in the authorityProfileURI field of the JWT Token Policy.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User JWT Token Policy Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client understands and uses the Authorization Service definition inside the JWT UserTokenPolicy returned with GetEndpoints. It shall support at least one of the following Authority Profile ConformanceUnits. The URIs defined in the ConformanceUnit are in the authorityProfileURI field of the JWT Token Policy exposed in Server Endpoints.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Management Server
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server exposes the "UserManagement" Object of UserManagementType and allows to manage users using the proper Methods.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Name Password 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports User Name/Password combination(s). The token will be encrypted as required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Name Password 2 Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: A Client uses a User Name/Password combination. The token will be encrypted if required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Name Password 3
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports User Name/Password combination(s). The token will be encrypted as required by the security policy of the User Token Policy or by the security policy of the endpoint.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Token Unencrypted
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server allows unencrypted tokens. An unencrypted token either requires message encryption or means outside the scope of OPC UA to secure the identity token so that it cannot be retrieved by sniffing the communication. One option would be a secure transport like a VPN.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User Token Unencrypted Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client allows unencrypted tokens. An unencrypted token either requires message encryption or means outside the scope of OPC UA to secure the identity token so that it cannot be retrieved by sniffing the communication. One option would be a secure transport like a VPN.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User X509
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Server supports a public/private key pair for user identity. The administrator shall be able to enable or disable the use of this feature including all validation steps which are defined for application instance certificates.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Security User X509 Client
ConformanceUnit.Description: A Client uses a public/private key pair for user identity.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SecurityPolicy Support
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least one Security Policy. Support of SecurityPolicy None is recommended for testing and compatibility reasons even if the UA Server supports a more secure policy.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SecurtyPolicy_None_Limits
ConformanceUnit.Description: DerivedSignatureKeyLength: 0

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the Session Service Set (CreateSession, ActivateSession, CloseSession) except the use of ActivateSession to change the Session user. This includes correct handling of all parameters that are provided. Note that for the CreateSession and ActivateSession services, if the SecurityMode = None then: 1) The Application Certificate and Nonce are optional. 2) The signatures are null/empty.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Cancel
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the Cancel Service to cancel outstanding requests.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Change User
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the use of ActivateSession to change the Session user.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Auto Reconnect
ConformanceUnit.Description: Automatic Client reconnect including: – ActivateSession with new SecureChannel if SecureChannel is no longer valid but Session is still valid – Creation of a new Session only if Session is no longer valid

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Base
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Session Service Set (CreateSession, ActivateSession, and CloseSession) except the use of ActivateSession to change the Session user. This includes correct handling of all parameters that are provided Note that for the CreateSession and ActivateSession services, if the SecurityMode = None then: 1) The Application Certificate and Nonce are optional. 2) The signatures are null/empty.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Cancel
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Cancel Service to cancel outstanding requests.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Detect Shutdown
ConformanceUnit.Description: Read or monitor the ServerStatus/State Variable to recognize a potential shutdown of the Server and start disconnecting.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client General Service Behaviour
ConformanceUnit.Description: Implement basic Service behaviour. This includes in particular: – including the proper authentication token of the Session – creating a requestHandle if needed – evaluate the serviceResult and operational results

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Impersonate
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses ActivateSession to change the Session user (impersonation).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client KeepAlive
ConformanceUnit.Description: Make periodic requests to keep the Session alive.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Multiple Connections
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support unlimited connections (client side) with multiple Servers. Any limit on numbers of connections is from server side. May have a memory based limit, but not a software constraint limit.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Renew NodeIds
ConformanceUnit.Description: This ConformanceUnit applies to Clients that allow persisting NodeIds. Verify that the Namespace Table has not changed for NodeIds that the Client has persisted and is going to re-use beyond a Session lifetime. If changes occurred the Client has to recalculate the Namespace Indices of the respective NodeIds.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client SessionLess Service Calls
ConformanceUnit.Description: Defines the use of the SessionlessInvoke Service to request one of the Services (like Read or Browse) that are allowed for sessionless invocation. UA Part 6 specifies which transports may be used and how.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Client Single Session
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client shall interoperate with Servers that only support one Session.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session General Service Behaviour
ConformanceUnit.Description: Implement basic Service behaviour. This includes in particular: – checking the authentication token – returning the requestHandle in responses – respecting a timeoutHint

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Multiple
ConformanceUnit.Description: Supports multiple Sessions from same or different Clients. Servers shall ensure that the Sessions operate in parallel (for example a long running operation shall not block another Session). This can be achieved for example by multi-threading for the Sessions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Session Sessionless Invocation
ConformanceUnit.Description: Defines the support of the SessionlessInvoke Service to process any of the Services (like Read/Write, Browse, or Call) that are designated for Session-less invocation.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Basic
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the following Subscription Services: CreateSubscription, ModifySubscription, DeleteSubscriptions, Publish, Republish and SetPublishingMode.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client Basic
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the Subscription and MonitoredItem Service Set as an efficient means to detect changes of Attribute values and / or to receive Event occurrences. Set appropriate intervals for publishing, keep alive notifications and total Subscription lifetime. Supply a sufficient number of Publish requests to the Server so that Notifications can be sent whenever a publish timer expires. Acknowledge received Notifications with subsequent Publish requests.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client Durable
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use durable Subscriptions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client Fallback
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client shall interoperate with Servers that do not support Subscriptions by only using Read Service.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client Modify
ConformanceUnit.Description: Allow modification of the Subscription configuration using the ModifySubscription Service.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client Multiple
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use multiple Subscriptions to reduce the payload of individual Notifications.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client Publish Multiple
ConformanceUnit.Description: Send multiple Publish Service requests to assure that the Server is always able to send Notifications.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client Republish
ConformanceUnit.Description: Evaluate the sequence number in Notifications to detect lost Notifications. Use Republish to request missing Notifications.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Client TransferSubscriptions
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client supports transferring Subscription from other Clients. This ConformanceUnit is used as part of redundant Clients.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Durable
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support setting Subscriptions in durable mode. This mode requires that collected data and events are stored and delivered even if a Client was disconnected for a longer time or the Server was restarted.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Durable StorageLevel High
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 2000 monitored items with a queue size of 200000 for each item and where the size of each MonitoredItem is at least equal to size of Double. This requires storage capacity for 400 million values of DataType Double.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Durable StorageLevel Medium
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 100 monitored items with a queue size of 50000 for each item and where the size of each MonitoredItem is at least equal to size of Double. This requires storage capacity for 5 million values of DataType Double.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Durable StorageLevel Small
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 20 monitored items with a queue size of 10000 for each item and where the size of each MonitoredItem is at least equal to size of Double. This requires storage capacity for 200 thousand values of DataType Double.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Minimum 02
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 2 Subscriptions per Session. This number has to be supported for at least half of the minimum required sessions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Minimum 05
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 5 Subscriptions per Session. This number has to be supported for at least half of the minimum required sessions.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Multiple
ConformanceUnit.Description: Server supports at least 2 Subscriptions in a single Session.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Publish Basic
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 2 Publish Service requests per Session.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Publish Min 05
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 5 Publish Service requests per Session. This number has to be supported for at least half of the minimum required sessions. Support, as a minimum, the number of Publish requests per session as the size of the NotificationMessage retransmission queue for Republish.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Publish Min 10
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least 10 Publish Service requests per Session. This number has to be supported for at least half of the minimum required sessions. Support, as a minimum, the number of Publish requests per session as the size of the NotificationMessage retransmission queue for Republish.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription PublishRequest Queue Overflow
ConformanceUnit.Description: If the maximum supported number of PublishRequests has been queued and a new PublishRequest arrives, the "oldest" PublishRequest has to be discarded by returning the proper error.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Retransmission Queue
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support a retransmission queue of sent NotificationMessages and the Republish Service. See UA Part 4 for the required size of the retransmission queue.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Subscription Transfer
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support TransferSubscriptions Service to transfer a Subscription from one Session to another.

Multiple blocks encrypted using the CBC mode described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/SP/nistspecialpublication800-38a.pdf. The key size is 128 bits. The block size is 16 bytes. The URI is http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#aes128-cbc.

Multiple blocks encrypted using the CTR mode described in http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/SP/nistspecialpublication800-38a.pdf. The counter block format is defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3686. The key size is 128 bits. The block size is 16 bytes. The input nonce length is 4 bytes. The URI is http://opcfoundation.org/UA/security/aes128-ctr.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm_AES128-GCM

The tag size is 16 bytes.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm_AES256-CBC

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm_AES256-CTR

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricEncryptionAlgorithm_AES256-GCM

ConformanceUnit.Description: An symmetric authenticated encryption algorithm defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8439

ConformanceUnit.Description: This algorithm does not apply.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_AES128-GCM
ConformanceUnit.Description: The AES encryption algorithm which is defined in https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/197/final. Data is encrypted using the GCM mode described in https://csrc.nist.rip/pubs/sp/800/38/d/final. GCM combines encryption and signing into a single algorithm. The key size is 128 bits. ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_AES256-GCM
ConformanceUnit.Description: The AES encryption algorithm which is defined in https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/197/final. Data is encrypted using the GCM mode described in https://csrc.nist.rip/pubs/sp/800/38/d/final. GCM combines encryption and signing into a single algorithm. The key size is 256 bits. ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_ChaCha20Poly1305
ConformanceUnit.Description: An AuthenticatedEncryption algorithm which creates a Signature as part of the encryption process defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8439. When using SignOnly, the encrypted data portion has zero length but it otherwise the same as SignAndEncrypt. The key is generated using the algorithm specified in 2.6 of RFC8439.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_HMAC-SHA1
ConformanceUnit.Description: A keyed hash which is defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2104. The hash algorithm is SHA1 and is described in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3174. The URI is http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#hmac-sha1. No known exploits exist when using SHA1 with a keyed hash, however, SHA1 was broken in 2017 so use of this algorithm is not recommended.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_HMAC-SHA2-256
ConformanceUnit.Description: A keyed hash used for message authentication which is defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2104. The hash algorithm is SHA2 with 256 bits and described in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4634

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_HMAC-SHA2-384
ConformanceUnit.Description: A keyed hash used for message authentication which is defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2104. The hash algorithm is SHA2 with 384 bits and described in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4634.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_None
ConformanceUnit.Description: This algorithm does not apply.

ConformanceUnit.Name: SymmetricSignatureAlgorithm_Poly1305
ConformanceUnit.Description:
An algorithm to create a message authentication code defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8439.
When using SignOnly, the Poly1305 key is generated using the algorithm specified in 2.6 of RFC8439.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Time Sync - Support
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support at least one of the optional ConformanceUnits for time synchronization mechanisms in the Security Time Synchronization Facet. The application documentation shall specify which synchronization mechanisms with which profiles are supported.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Time Sync – IEEE 1588 (PTP)
ConformanceUnit.Description: Application supports time synchronization via the Precision Time Protocol (PTP).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Time Sync – IEEE 802.1AS
ConformanceUnit.Description: Application supports time synchronization via the features described in IEEE 802.1AS.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Time Sync – NTP
ConformanceUnit.Description: Application supports time synchronization via the Network Time Protocol (NTP).

ConformanceUnit.Name: Time Sync – OS based support
ConformanceUnit.Description: Application supports time synchronization via features of a standard operating system.

ConformanceUnit.Name: Time Sync – UA based support
ConformanceUnit.Description: Application supports time synchronization by use of the request or response header timestamps provided by a configured well known source, such as a Discovery Server to synchronize the time on the application and that this time synchronization occurs periodically. Use of this TimeSyncing can be configured.

ConformanceUnit.Name: UA Binary Encoding
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support UA Binary Encoding. Values of these data types are encoded in compact binary formats, contiguously and without tagging. I.e. the receiver is assumed to understand the structure it is decoding.

ConformanceUnit.Name: UA Secure Conversation
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support UA Secure Conversation specified in UA Part 6.

ConformanceUnit.Name: UA SOAP-XML Encoding
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support Soap V1.2 based Xml Encoding defined in UA Part 6. The XML elements include all information necessary to convert it back into OPC UA structures of any language.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Basic 2
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the View Service Set (Browse, BrowseNext). This includes the support of minimum 1 continuation point per Session.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Client Basic Browse
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses Browse and BrowseNext Services to navigate through the Server's OPC UA AddressSpace. In order to navigate efficiently through big address spaces we recommend to make use of the referenceTypeId and the nodeClassMask to specify the needed References.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Client Basic ResultSet Filtering
ConformanceUnit.Description: Makes use of the resultMask parameter to optimize the result set to be returned by the Server.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Client Basic SessionLess
ConformanceUnit.Description: Use the View Services - in particular Browse - with the SessionLessInvoke Service.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Client RegisterNodes
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the RegisterNodes Service to optimize access for Nodes that are used repeatedly. Use UnregisterNodes when Nodes are not used anymore.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Client Remote Nodes Browse
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can browse to nodes that have an extended NodeID that reference a Server different than the originating Server. This includes automatic connection to the remote Server. It is acceptable that the Server configuration information be pre-configured on the Client and / or that the user is prompted to connect.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Client Remote Nodes Translate Browse
ConformanceUnit.Description: The Client can translate browse paths that include nodes with extended NodeID that reference a Server different than the originating Server and return them as part of the TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIds Service. It is acceptable that the Server configuration information be pre-configured on the Client.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View Client TranslateBrowsePath
ConformanceUnit.Description: Uses the TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIds Service to identify the NodeIds for Nodes where a starting Node and a BrowsePath is known. Makes use of bulk operations rather than multiple calls whenever possible.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View RegisterNodes
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support the RegisterNodes and UnregisterNodes Services as a way to optimize access to repeatedly used Nodes in the Server's OPC UA AddressSpace.

ConformanceUnit.Name: View TranslateBrowsePath
ConformanceUnit.Description: Support TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIds Service.
